fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM57,355. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0008601/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: SPM or equivalent with minimum 3 credits; OR SPM with minimum 1 credit and SKM Level 3; OR Recognised certificate in related field (Level 3, MQF); OR Pass certificate (Level 3, MQF) from PTPL/Polytechnic/IKM in related field; OR Pass UEC with at least Grade B in 3 subjects; OR Pass O-Level with at least Grade C in 3 subjects; OR Pass SKM Level 3 in related field and pass SPM with at least 1 credit; OR Pass certificate from Kolej Komuniti (Level 3, MQF) in related field and pass SPM with at least 1 credit; OR Pass STPM or equivalent with at least Grade C (CGPA 2.00) in 1 subject; OR Pass STAM (Maqbul level); OR Any other equivalent qualification recognised by the Malaysian Government.
